title: Clarifying Maximum Upload Size for a team

question.author: member_227
question.body: Before I explain maximum upload size to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Storage Limits documentation says: If a web upload fails near 2 GB, switch to the desktop client — this is expected behavior, not a bug. The 20 GB desktop limit was introduced in CloudBox 2.0 (September 2023); earlier versions were limited to 5 GB. Uploads that exceed the limit fail with the error "File too large". You can upload files up to 20 GB in size through the desktop and mobile clients, and through the API. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
